summary: community.general deprecates the manifold lookup plugin and the stackpath_compute inventory plugin for removal in 11.0.0.
questions: Is the manifold lookup being removed?
Is the stackpath_compute inventory plugin deprecated?

answer_card.title: manifold and stackpath_compute deprecated
answer_card.answer_md: The `manifold` lookup and the `stackpath_compute` inventory plugin are deprecated and will be removed in community.general 11.0.0.
